newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to higher.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose at the short end of the curve, while the rest of the maturities were unchanged, traders said on Thursday.
The one-week and two-week maturities nudged higher, reflecting the still tight peso liquidity, dealers said.
Despite the slight easing in money market rates, a dealer said "the market is still tight. We're looking at easing sometime next week."
Some 5 billion pesos worth of government securities are expected to mature next week which should loosen the tight liquidity situation, the same dealer said.
